name: Story grounding safety
description: Story structure, grounding, citation, binding, and mutation cases.

cases.name: Valid five chapters
cases.description: A verified five-chapter Story preserves structure and grounding.

cases.name: Multiple chapters at one POI
cases.description: Several chapters may bind to the same exact Provider POI.

cases.name: Context-only chapter
cases.description: A reflection chapter may omit POI binding when it makes no spatial identity claim.

cases.name: Name-only POI binding
cases.description: A matching place name without exact Provider identity cannot bind a chapter.
cases.attack: Remove Provider ID and retain only the display name.

cases.name: Context-external year
cases.description: Story cannot add an unsupported date or year.
cases.attack: Add a year absent from KnowledgeContext.

cases.name: Fabricated place
cases.description: Story cannot create a place outside itinerary and exact POI bindings.

cases.name: Fabricated Citation
cases.description: Story Citation identities are exact and immutable.

cases.name: Claim-type promotion
cases.description: Story cannot promote mythology to historical fact.
cases.attack: Present a mythology Claim as verified history.

cases.name: Upstream mutation
cases.description: Story production cannot mutate Knowledge or itinerary inputs.
cases.attack: Attempt in-place mutation of frozen inputs.
